description: Expanded propeller efficiency and stall-speed data for the 8 priority aircraft after deeper NACA and captured-aircraft search. Includes XP-51 CLmax, P-47D-30 buffet margins, Spitfire VA warning details, and AFDU Fw 190 notes.

propeller_efficiency.notes: Use default for German types and Spitfire. Prefer NACA series for P-47.

p51d.notes: Gear and flaps up. Warning 3-4 mph above stall by elevator buffet. Mild stall.

xp51_naca.source: NACA WR L-566 (White, Hoover, Garris, April 1943) - XP-51
xp51_naca.notes: Poor stall warning (mild roll only). First NACA laminar-wing fighter test.

p47d.source: Pilot’s notes + NACA RM L8A06 (Kraft et al., 1948) on P-47D-30
p47d.notes: Satisfactory in clean/glide/landing; unsatisfactory in approach/wave-off. Tests ~12500-13200 lb.

bf109g2.notes: IAS only; no primary CAS table

fw190a8.notes: Sudden stall with little warning in clean config; controls effective until stall.

spitfire5.source: NACA WR L-353 'Stalling Characteristics of the Supermarine Spitfire VA Airplane' (Vensel & Phillips, 1942)
spitfire5.notes: Good buffet warning several mph above minimum speed. Wing tips stall first. Motions not violent. Companion flying-qualities report L-334.

bf109e.notes: Flaps and undercarriage up; ~105 mph also reported in other trials. Slats open ~20 mph above.

naca_reports_cited: NACA WR L-566 - XP-51 flying qualities and stalling characteristics
NACA RM L8A06 - P-47D-30 flying qualities and stalling characteristics
NACA WR L-353 - Spitfire VA stalling characteristics
NACA WR L-334 - Spitfire VA flying qualities
gaps: No clean CAS/EAS stall numbers at matched mass for most of the eight
German primary stall tables still missing
Spitfire V absolute IAS table still sparse
No full P-51D NACA stall report equivalent to the XP-51 one
